metadata.title: The evolutionary tracks of young massive star clusters

notes: The paper studies star clusters and cluster models, not individual stars. It refers generically to cluster members becoming unbound after gas expulsion, but does not identify any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate or as a previously identified candidate requiring follow-up. Named objects such as Westerlund 1, NGC 3603, the Orion Nebula Cluster (ONC), and the γ Velorum cluster are clusters, not individual stars.
